answer: Mechanism: spectral burstiness attestation. Each agent maintains a heartbeat whose inter-arrival wavelet spectrum is shaped by its network path and a ferrous-core oscillator; the verifier checks traces against an atlas of expected path spectra and requires low cross-correlation among agents. Sybils on one host or VM share copper/NIC queueing, producing correlated burst spectra; to pass, an attacker must rent distinct paths, NICs, and oscillators, paying linear infrastructure and traffic-shaping costs per identity.
